# Global distribution partner for raw materials

## Active worldwide for a variety of industries

We have been your reliable partner for high-quality ingredients for more than four decades. Based in
Hamburg we offer raw materials for food, feed, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and technical applications
around the globe!

[Product finder][40][Contact][41]

## Our industries

### High-quality solutions for every sector

Our top priority is to deliver exactly what you need – the right product, in the right quantity,
exactly where and when you need it. To ensure consistent quality, we carefully coordinate the supply
of raw materials. With 14 strategically located sites and 11 warehouse facilities worldwide, we
offer safe and reliable delivery of your ingredients.

## Frequently asked questions

Where is ACT located?

ACT is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, and has 14 [locations][74] worlwide. Our interactive map
shows you all locations and their contact details. So you can reach us at any time.

Which raw materials does ACT distribute?

We have been your reliable partner for high-quality ingredients for four decades. As a Hamburg
company, we offer quality raw materials for food, feed, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and technical
applications.

[Follow this link][75] to get an overview of the different sectors that we supply with our quality
raw materials.

How can I be sure that the products meet the specific quality?

Our long-term partnerships build on our consistently high quality and customer satisfaction. Our
internal [quality][76] management department continuously checks the approval of suppliers and raw
materials. We work with independent test laboratories to ensure meaningful monitoring.

Is ACT a certified distributor for quality raw materials?

Yes, ACT is certified in multiple categories and can always deliver the best possible quality. For a
full list and download links to our certifications please visit our [quality ][77]page.

## Frequently asked questions

Where is ACT located?

ACT is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, and has 14 [locations][74] worlwide. Our interactive map
shows you all locations and their contact details. So you can reach us at any time.

Which raw materials does ACT distribute?

We have been your reliable partner for high-quality ingredients for four decades. As a Hamburg
company, we offer quality raw materials for food, feed, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and technical
applications.

[Follow this link][75] to get an overview of the different sectors that we supply with our quality
raw materials.

How can I be sure that the products meet the specific quality?

Our long-term partnerships build on our consistently high quality and customer satisfaction. Our
internal [quality][76] management department continuously checks the approval of suppliers and raw
materials. We work with independent test laboratories to ensure meaningful monitoring.

Is ACT a certified distributor for quality raw materials?

Yes, ACT is certified in multiple categories and can always deliver the best possible quality. For a
full list and download links to our certifications please visit our [quality ][77]page.

#

## Welcome to ACTI-CHEM SA

Acti-Chem’s roots in South Africa were firmly entrenched 40 years ago, providing innovative and
technologically advanced chemicals to local industries and customers abroad. Often unseen by their
users, Acti-Chem products can be found in a variety of industries from newspapers to cosmetics, from
building and construction to high fashion.

** Supported by an ongoing commitment to research and development, ACTI-CHEM's activities centre on
the production and supply of a wide range of biocides, disinfectant products, flame retardants and
personal care ingredients.**

[[Biocides]][54] [BIOCIDES][55]

ACTI-CHEM has a wide range of **ACTICIDE^{®}** biocides  for the safe and effective preservation of
a multitude of industrial and consumer products.

[[Disinfectants]][56] [DISINFECTION][57]

ACTI-CHEM is a leading producer of **ACTICIDE^{®}** disinfectant actives based on quaternary
ammonium compounds for diverse markets and applications.

[[Flame Retardants]][58] [FLAME
RETARDANTS][59]

ACTI-CHEM is an established name in the development and production of **AFLAMMIT^{®}**
environmentally acceptable flame retardant products.

[[Personal Care]][60] [PERSONAL
CARE][61]

ACTI-CHEM's **Microcare^{®}** range includes high purity preservatives and emollients, globally
approved quat and amine conditioning products and silicones for skin and hair care.

# Home
* FortiCulture CoconutAs consumers continue to seek sustainability and safety in their products,
  multifunctional antimicrobials are a clear choice. Inspired by our commitment to sustainable
  solutions, Active Micro Technologies has adopted a Cradle to Cradle approach, using the coconuts
  we source to their fullest to minimize our footprint and maximize skin care benefits. Coconut oil,
  when fractionated into smaller molecules called medium chain triglycerides (MCTs), provides ideal
  fermentation conditions for yeast, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, to unlock the water-soluble
  lipopeptides standardized in FortiCulture Coconut. More than just sustainably sourced, the
  lipopeptides in FortiCulture Coconut perform two key functions: 1) When topically applied,
  lipopeptides signal keratinocytes to release antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), which regulate the
  skin barrier and increase collagen production. 2) Lipopeptides are naturally antimicrobial and
  provide a broad-spectrum fortress for a wide range of formulation applications. Fortify the skin
  barrier and final formulations with FortiCulture Coconut, a formulation-friendly natural
  antimicrobial with cellular anti-aging benefits.[Read More ][51]
* Leucidal® SF Max PowderLeucidal® SF Max Powder embodies the "less is more" philosophy, packing a
  powerful punch in its powdered form. This advanced version of Leucidal® SF Max boasts five times
  the potency of the original, allowing formulators to save precious time while delivering unmatched
  efficacy with a heightened sense of confidence.[Read More][52]
* PHYTOCIDE LICHEN PhytoCide Lichen from Cladonia Rangiferina a unique active rich
  in usnic acid that provides broad-spectrum protection for cosmetic applications with good
  compliancy in anionic systems. Usnic acid has a wide range of biological activity, most notably
  antibacterial activity against plant and human infections, as well as inhibitory effect against
  antibiotic-resistant bacterial strains. With antioxidant capabilities, this new active will also
  help protect the skin from oxidative stress and cell aging.[Read more][53]

## EXPLORE OUR PRODUCT PORTFOLIO BELOW

## THE MODERN PRESERVATION MARKET

The personal care market has opened its eyes to the growing demand for proactive, innovative and
alternative solutions to synthetic preservatives. Manufacturers add preservatives to formulations in
order to control bacterial and fungal growth, extending the shelf-life of these products. However,
many synthetic preservatives are falling from favor with regulators and consumers alike due to
issues like sensitization and other health related concerns. By developing materials exhibiting
cosmetic benefits, Active Micro Technologies has, in turn, created effective and natural
antimicrobials. Now our customers can continue leading the market with their impressive formulations
and innovative applications!

[CONTINUE READING][54]


## ACTIVE MICRO TECHNOLOGIES COMPANY OVERVIEW

In recent years the Personal Care Industry has seen an increased demand for environmentally
conscious and ethically sound products. Consumers’ desire for naturally derived and inspired
products has only grown more pronounced as public awareness of traditional preservation increases.

With a noticeable shift in both formulator preference and consumer attitude, traditional
preservatives (parabens, formaldehyde-donors, thiazolinones, etc.) have found themselves under
scrutiny. Continued market-focus on “carry over” ingredients effecting health and sustainability,
coupled with the booming naturals trend, have slowly ousted conventional preservatives from product
ingredient decks. Active Micro Technologies predicted this trend and is the market leader in
preservation alternatives.

# Home
* FortiCulture CoconutAs consumers continue to seek sustainability and safety in their products,
  multifunctional antimicrobials are a clear choice. Inspired by our commitment to sustainable
  solutions, Active Micro Technologies has adopted a Cradle to Cradle approach, using the coconuts
  we source to their fullest to minimize our footprint and maximize skin care benefits. Coconut oil,
  when fractionated into smaller molecules called medium chain triglycerides (MCTs), provides ideal
  fermentation conditions for yeast, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, to unlock the water-soluble
  lipopeptides standardized in FortiCulture Coconut. More than just sustainably sourced, the
  lipopeptides in FortiCulture Coconut perform two key functions: 1) When topically applied,
  lipopeptides signal keratinocytes to release antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), which regulate the
  skin barrier and increase collagen production. 2) Lipopeptides are naturally antimicrobial and
  provide a broad-spectrum fortress for a wide range of formulation applications. Fortify the skin
  barrier and final formulations with FortiCulture Coconut, a formulation-friendly natural
  antimicrobial with cellular anti-aging benefits.[Read More ][51]
* Leucidal® SF Max PowderLeucidal® SF Max Powder embodies the "less is more" philosophy, packing a
  powerful punch in its powdered form. This advanced version of Leucidal® SF Max boasts five times
  the potency of the original, allowing formulators to save precious time while delivering unmatched
  efficacy with a heightened sense of confidence.[Read More][52]
* PHYTOCIDE LICHEN PhytoCide Lichen from Cladonia Rangiferina a unique active rich
  in usnic acid that provides broad-spectrum protection for cosmetic applications with good
  compliancy in anionic systems. Usnic acid has a wide range of biological activity, most notably
  antibacterial activity against plant and human infections, as well as inhibitory effect against
  antibiotic-resistant bacterial strains. With antioxidant capabilities, this new active will also
  help protect the skin from oxidative stress and cell aging.[Read more][53]

## EXPLORE OUR PRODUCT PORTFOLIO BELOW

## THE MODERN PRESERVATION MARKET

The personal care market has opened its eyes to the growing demand for proactive, innovative and
alternative solutions to synthetic preservatives. Manufacturers add preservatives to formulations in
order to control bacterial and fungal growth, extending the shelf-life of these products. However,
many synthetic preservatives are falling from favor with regulators and consumers alike due to
issues like sensitization and other health related concerns. By developing materials exhibiting
cosmetic benefits, Active Micro Technologies has, in turn, created effective and natural
antimicrobials. Now our customers can continue leading the market with their impressive formulations
and innovative applications!

[CONTINUE READING][54]


## ACTIVE MICRO TECHNOLOGIES COMPANY OVERVIEW

In recent years the Personal Care Industry has seen an increased demand for environmentally
conscious and ethically sound products. Consumers’ desire for naturally derived and inspired
products has only grown more pronounced as public awareness of traditional preservation increases.

With a noticeable shift in both formulator preference and consumer attitude, traditional
preservatives (parabens, formaldehyde-donors, thiazolinones, etc.) have found themselves under
scrutiny. Continued market-focus on “carry over” ingredients effecting health and sustainability,
coupled with the booming naturals trend, have slowly ousted conventional preservatives from product
ingredient decks. Active Micro Technologies predicted this trend and is the market leader in
preservation alternatives.

# alexmo cosmetics

alexmo cosmetics steht für hochwertige Rohstoffe zur Herstellung der eigenen Kosmetik, ob pflegende
oder dekorative Kosmetik, Seifen- oder Parfum-Kreationen.

Bei uns bekommen Sie alle Zutaten für das schönste Hobby rund um den Beauty-Zirkel. Wir liefern
innovative Emulgatoren, milde Tenside, Öle, Pflanzenextrakte, Hydrolate und Pigmente, sowie eine
große Auswahl an Wirkstoffen für jeden Hauttyp.

Um das Herz der Selbstrührer bzw. DIY-Kosmetik höher schlagen zu lassen, bieten wir ebenfalls
Airlessspender, Dosen und Flaschen, sowie das komplette Equipment für die Rührküche, wie
Bechergläser, Laborthermometer und Mixgeräte etc. an.

Fühlen Sie sich eingeladen und stöbern Sie nach Herzenslust durch unseren Shop. Sollten Sie
Anregungen benötigen, finden Sie in unserer Rezeptwelt schöne Rezepte für Ihre selbst hergestellten
Cremes & Lotionen.

# alexmo cosmetics

alexmo cosmetics steht für hochwertige Rohstoffe zur Herstellung der eigenen Kosmetik, ob pflegende
oder dekorative Kosmetik, Seifen- oder Parfum-Kreationen.

Bei uns bekommen Sie alle Zutaten für das schönste Hobby rund um den Beauty-Zirkel. Wir liefern
innovative Emulgatoren, milde Tenside, Öle, Pflanzenextrakte, Hydrolate und Pigmente, sowie eine
große Auswahl an Wirkstoffen für jeden Hauttyp.

Um das Herz der Selbstrührer bzw. DIY-Kosmetik höher schlagen zu lassen, bieten wir ebenfalls
Airlessspender, Dosen und Flaschen, sowie das komplette Equipment für die Rührküche, wie
Bechergläser, Laborthermometer und Mixgeräte etc. an.

Fühlen Sie sich eingeladen und stöbern Sie nach Herzenslust durch unseren Shop. Sollten Sie
Anregungen benötigen, finden Sie in unserer Rezeptwelt schöne Rezepte für Ihre selbst hergestellten
Cremes & Lotionen.

## Service for Functional Food Ingredients

Service for Functional Food Ingredients

Functional food ingredients include a range of biologically active compounds with health benefits.
**Aprofood** is focused on advancing research on these ingredients, providing services in
developing, characterizing, and optimizing manufacturing processes for these key ingredients, as
well as evaluating the health benefits of functional foods.

][219]

[Service for Food Technological Additives]

## Service for Food Technological Additives

Service for Food Technological Additives

Food technical additives are widely used in food processing to enhance texture, improve appearance,
extend shelf life, stabilize ingredients, or aid in processing. **Aprofood** offers development,
characterization, and optimization services for a wide range of technical additives, including
enzymes and fermenters.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

 

 

## Where we’re making news

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers
are making news around the globe. Here are some of the latest stories.

[Shenzhen Curon Pet Co. Ltd. - Pet Food Manufacturer]
About Us

## Who We Are

Shenzhen Curon Pet Co., Ltd. is based in Shenzhen, China — one of the world's most dynamic
manufacturing hubs. We are a dedicated pet nutrition manufacturer with a clear mission: to create
products that genuinely improve the health and happiness of pets around the globe.

Founded on the principles of quality, transparency, and scientific innovation, Curon Pet has grown
from a focused domestic supplier into a trusted international partner for pet brands, distributors,
and retailers across more than 30 countries.

Our team of nutritionists, food scientists, and quality engineers collaborates closely with clients
to develop products that meet the highest standards of safety and efficacy. We believe that every
pet deserves the best nutrition, and every brand partner deserves a manufacturer they can fully
trust.

Product Portfolio

## Comprehensive Pet Nutrition Solutions

Curon Pet offers a diverse range of **dry and wet pet food, natural treats, functional snacks, and
specialized nutrition formulas** designed to support every stage of a pet's life.

🥩

### Dry Pet Food

Nutritionally balanced kibble formulas for dogs and cats, available in various protein sources
including chicken, salmon, beef, and lamb. Designed for daily feeding and complete nutrition.

🥫

### Wet Pet Food

High-moisture canned and pouch formats providing palatability and hydration. Ideal for picky eaters
and senior pets. Available in pâté, chunks in gravy, and shredded varieties.

Easychem is a leading manufacturer and distributor for**[ cosmetics preservative][54], [industrial

[personal care][63], [home care][64], [water treatment][65], [paints and coating][66] and industrial
applications**. We provide tailored solutions to meet customer needs, ensuring safety and

With years of expertise, we focus on high-performance [**antimicrobial solutions**.][67] While
others diversify, our R&D team remains committed to advancing [**preservatives and biocides**][68]
technology to the highest standards.

## Featured  [preservatives][74] and [biocides][75]

**Easychem** is a professional **preservative and biocide supplier** serving customers in personal
care, home care and industrial fields worldwide.

We specialize in the supply of **high-performance preservatives**, antimicrobial agents and biocides
used in cosmetics, detergents, disinfectants, coatings, water treatment and other industrial
formulations. Our core products include **CMIT/MIT**, **PHMB**, **BIT**, **DMDM Hydantoin**,
**Bronopol**, and modern preservative blends such as **PE91**.

With years of experience in chemical raw materials, Easychem helps formulators and manufacturers
solve common challenges such as microbial contamination, shelf-life extension, regulatory compliance
and cost optimization. Our products are available in liquid and powder forms, suitable for a wide pH
range and different formulation systems.

# [Sourdough Symphony][43]

Join us in the craft of sourdough baking, exploring the rich history, science, and art behind this
ancient bread. Together, we'll create crusty, soulful masterpieces right from your home oven.

## Texas-Proud and Meaning It

#### [Taco Loco][44]

Aside from BBQ, another food item that is typically associated with Texas is the lovely Taco! Get
the best information on this Texan (and American) favorite from tips and tricks to making the best
tacos, taco origins, and even in-depth information on the different specialty taco types!

#### [Butter Lasso][45]

Wrangle up your taste buds and get ready for a wild ride! Our blog is dedicated to exploring the
delicious world of cowboy butter. From savory recipes to creative pairing ideas, we'll show you how
to elevate your dishes with this flavorful spread. Grab your apron and let's get cooking!

#### [Lone Star Germania][46]

Willkommen! Discover the rich tapestry of German culture woven into the heart of Texas. From the
first waves of immigration to the enduring traditions, language, and cuisine, we explore the
fascinating stories and vibrant communities that have shaped the German experience in the Lone Star
State. Join us on this journey!

#### [Spurs & Spirits][47]

The paleo diet emphasizes eating like early humans, focusing on whole foods and excluding grains,

# The ICI Difference

"Our history is in corn wet milling; our 40 years of experience is in distribution;
and our pride is in the success of our customers."

#### Rick Crowder, ICI Foods

### Industry Experience

ICI Foods has been in the business for over 40 years. Being in the industry that long gives us
unique insight into the business and allows us to better serve you.

### One Source Solution

We have strong partnerships with over 45 of the finest ingredient suppliers and a network of
nationwide distribution centers ready to supply all of your needs.

### Product Expertise

Our talented team spends so much time learning about our suppliers' products that they can help you
pick exactly the right ingredient for your specific need.

### Just In Time Delivery

Our nationwide network of distribution centers allows us to keep the right inventory in the right
places. We can deliver the freshest ingredients to your business exactly when it is needed.

ICI Foods has been a long standing supplier and continues to provide us with competitive pricing,
excellent customer service and quality products. Our sales representative is extremely knowledgeable
and works to provide us with the right sourcing opportunities to meet our business needs.

#### Purchasing Manager

**Branded Food Manufacturer**

### For over 40 years...

ICI Foods has been the distributor of choice for companies looking for the highest quality
ingredients and the best possible service. We supply everything from freight-car loads of sugar for
industrial manufacturers down to individual bags of flour for local bakeries, and we can help you
make the best-tasting food you can imagine.

# FOod additive


Food additives are the chemicals or the substances added to the food products in order to keep them
fresh and to provide enhancement to their texture and flavour. They are added only to the food items
that are not included in the GRAS (generally recognized as Safe) list. This GRAS list includes the
names of only those items which have been in use for long and have not shown any adverse signs. Food
items like salt, sugar and flour have been included in this list. Sellers also need prior Government
approval for adding Food additives in their products.

Food additives include flavour enhancers, preservatives and a variety of food colouring products
like cochineal. They are safe, as only the additives which are found to be safe and having no
adverse effect are approved by the Government. In most cases, food additives mentioned on the label
are included in the other ingredients section. While sometimes their names are clearly mentioned
while at number of times they are also mentioned with their codes. It is important to add food
additives, to some food items so as to maintain the safety of the product through its journey from
factories to warehouse and throughout the process of its transportation to finally making it
available to the end users.

[No More Pills!]

# No more reflux, no incisions, no more PPIs!

###### The TIF^{®} procedure, the ***only*** solution that effectively treats reflux without
###### incisions or metal implants.

[See if the TIF procedure is right for you ][9]

The FDA is clear on their stance regarding PPIs—the label says:

#### No more than three 14-day treatment courses should be used in one year.”¹


The TIF procedure is minimally invasive and corrects the root cause of reflux – a faulty valve
between the esophagus and stomach. If you are taking proton pump inhibitors such as Prilosec^{®} and
Nexium^{®} to control your symptoms, you now have a safe and effective alternative.

[81% of parients are off PPPIs post TIF procedure]

##### “The TIF procedure for reflux fixes the root cause, providing patients with long-lasting
##### relief. We visit Kenneth Chang, MD a doctor at UC Irvine in Orange County, California, to
##### learn more about the procedure and hear from one of his patients about the reflux and
##### heartburn she felt since childhood and how the TIF® procedure has changed her life for
##### the better.”

Your browser does not support the video tag.

Merit Medical defines the term “cTIF” as a consecutive Transoral Incisionless Fundoplication which
consists of a Hiatal Hernia Repair (HHR) followed by a Transoral Incisionless Fundoplication (TIF)
procedure under a single anesthesia setting.

## Get back to YOU

Imagine the relief you will feel by choosing to restore the valve, fixing the cause of reflux, not
just a temporary band-aid to control symptoms.

#### Answer these 7 Questions and you’ll be on your way to ending reflux and reliance on PPIs.

[I’m ready for relief! ][10]

[Get Back to YOU]

#### “My TIF procedure date is more significant than my birthday.”

—Shannon N.

## The TIF procedure delivers relief
* Minimally invasive:
  *Fast recovery*
* Restores valve to natural state:
  *Maintain normal bodily functions*
* No incisions:
  *No scars*
* No dissection of stomach:
  *No scar tissue*

## The TIF procedure has helped thousands of people put a stop to reflux.

Deciding on a course of action when treating reflux can be confusing. The first step may be symptom
control with PPIs. But when you exceed the FDA approved course of treatment with PPIs, the time has
come to eliminate reflux.

[22,000 + TIF procedures]

27,000+
TIF procedures

[2007]

FDA cleared since 2007

81% off daily PPIs²

procedure.

[Your journey starts HERE ][11]

#### “The TIF procedure is extremely safe, it is extremely effective, and it keeps my patients off
#### of PPIs. I would not put this off. Have the TIF procedure before further damage occurs from
#### acid reflux.”

—Dr. William Barnes, who has performed over 600 successful TIF procedures, is the Chief of Surgery &
Trauma Director for Livingston Hospital and Healthcare Services, Inc., Salem, KY

[Watch Dr. Barnes’ Video ][12]

   patients reporting no daily use of PPIs.

## How We Work

#### Primary Research

The primary research is performed by taking the interviews of executives of various companies
dealing in the market as well as using the survey reports, research institute, and latest research
reports. Meanwhile, analyst team keeps preparing set of questionnaires and after getting appointee
list; the target audience are then tapped and segregated with various mediums and channels that are
feasible for making connection.

#### Secondary Research

The secondary resources considered for the study include company annual reports, press releases,
published articles of organizations and associations, and the survey taken through different
mediums. In addition, the valuable strategic information obtained from industry association, paid
database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and
insights.

[images]

#### Data Validation

Once the primary & secondary research phase is completed, the collected information is framed
stating a view point of current market status. The most important question is the ongoing scenarios
of the market and correlating recent development activity; this must be utilized before any
player/manufacturer can go and formulate business plans and strategic tactics.

#### Report Compilation

Our research methodology is a built-in philosophy of quality assurance & control and continuing
improvement is integral to the HTF Market Intelligence culture. Each analyst team bears final
responsibility for the quality and accuracy of their reports. This is achieved through a process of
cross-verification and comparison among alternative estimators. Estimates are thus verified and
refined to help guarantee superior, accurate results for our clients.

### Natural food preservatives manufacturers

ITA began with its founding in the 80s and grew up with its second generation of the family.
We are chemists, food technologists, clerks and factory workers that love working here.
We have been working for thirty years in order supporting the shelf life of the great Italian food
industry products and we have lived in first person the change of the food sector which made us
understand that the less it is chemical, the more is real!
We do not resell third-party ingredients or simple commodities, but produce us **natural
preservatives for food industry**, as it is more important selecting and researching instead of
manipulating the raw material.
We enjoy working. That's why, if we tell you that we carefully follow our production and your
products, you should believe us.

Our mission is become a point of reference among the [natural food preservatives manufacturers][24]
all over the word.

HIGHLIGHTS
[[Natural shelf life extenders for bakery, pastry and desserts? They are surely Made in ITA! ]][26]

## NATURAL SHELF LIFE EXTENDERS FOR BAKERY, PASTRY AND DESSERTS? THEY ARE SURELY MADE IN ITA!

A few years ago we decided to produce only natural shelf life extenders - natural ingredients that
are used in recipes to achieve a specific goal, such as prolonging the life of baked goods, pastries
or desserts - or preserving their appearance longer. We took the opportunity to eliminate the
chemical components of traditional food preservatives and life extensions and we focused on the
products that you can find on our website and you can only buy from us. What a golden opportunity!

[Read more][27]
 
[[Surface mould, bye bye.]][28]

## SURFACE MOULD, BYE BYE.

It’s a natural aromatic preparation, which vaporizes before packaging, it is also used in organic
products and does not alter the smell and taste when the packet is opened: instead it cancels the
effect of the alcoholic "flush". The new Complesso Limone® SPK is the killer of surface moulds and
is a signature product of ITA FOOD IMPROVERS®.

### Natural food preservatives manufacturers

ITA began with its founding in the 80s and grew up with its second generation of the family.
We are chemists, food technologists, clerks and factory workers that love working here.
We have been working for thirty years in order supporting the shelf life of the great Italian food
industry products and we have lived in first person the change of the food sector which made us
understand that the less it is chemical, the more is real!
We do not resell third-party ingredients or simple commodities, but produce us **natural
preservatives for food industry**, as it is more important selecting and researching instead of
manipulating the raw material.
We enjoy working. That's why, if we tell you that we carefully follow our production and your
products, you should believe us.

Our mission is become a point of reference among the [natural food preservatives manufacturers][24]
all over the word.

[Read more][25]
HIGHLIGHTS
[[Natural shelf life extenders for bakery, pastry and desserts? They are surely Made in ITA! ]][26]

## NATURAL SHELF LIFE EXTENDERS FOR BAKERY, PASTRY AND DESSERTS? THEY ARE SURELY MADE IN ITA!

A few years ago we decided to produce only natural shelf life extenders - natural ingredients that
are used in recipes to achieve a specific goal, such as prolonging the life of baked goods, pastries
or desserts - or preserving their appearance longer. We took the opportunity to eliminate the
chemical components of traditional food preservatives and life extensions and we focused on the
products that you can find on our website and you can only buy from us. What a golden opportunity!

[Read more][27]
 
[[Surface mould, bye bye.]][28]

## SURFACE MOULD, BYE BYE.

It’s a natural aromatic preparation, which vaporizes before packaging, it is also used in organic
products and does not alter the smell and taste when the packet is opened: instead it cancels the
effect of the alcoholic "flush". The new Complesso Limone® SPK is the killer of surface moulds and
is a signature product of ITA FOOD IMPROVERS®.

[Read more][29]

## Testimonials

We have been buying various chemicals and pharmaceutical intermediates from Multichem since about
2009. Over the years, they have demonstrated excellence in product quality and service consistently.
Being in the pharmaceutical sector, quality and reliability are extremely important and Multichem
has always delivered on both fronts. Their team’s expertise, timely delivery, and commitment to
understanding our unique needs have made them an invaluable part of our supply chain. We look
forward to continuing our strong collaboration with Multichem in the years to come.

###### Aurobindo Pharma Ltd.

###### Ramesh Kumar Nair

###### Sr. General Manager - Purchase

Partnering with Multichem has been a great step in expanding our reach in India. Their focus on
quality, market knowledge, and dependable service has made them an essential part of our
distribution network. We feel confident knowing our products are handled with care and
professionalism.

###### LANXESS Deutschland GmbH

###### Pedro Garcia Giacon

###### Global Product Manager for Hygiene,
###### Business Line Hygiene & Care,
###### BU Material Protection Products

I have had the pleasure of working with Multichem since 1984, marking a partnership of over 40
years. Initially, I worked with the late Mr. Shiv Dayal Karnani, whose dedication to quality and
customer service build a strong foundation for our relationship. Now, under the leadership of his
son Manish, that legacy of excellence continues. Multichem’s consistent quality and professionalism
have been invaluable to our operations, and I look forward to many more successful years of
collaboration.

###### Arudra Engineers Pvt. Ltd.

###### R. Natraj

###### Managing Director

Since partnering with Multichem about 10 years ago, we’ve been impressed by their well-coordinated
import logistics team and smooth customs processes. Their expertise and commitment to excellence
have made them a reliable partner, and we look forward to building a strong, long-term relationship.

###### Clearfast Air Cargo Agencies Pvt. Ltd.

###### Sandeep Kulkarni

###### Director

We have had the privilege of working with Multichem for over 20 years, and their professionalism and
efficiency have been exemplary. Their import logistics team is exceptionally well-organized,
ensuring smooth operations and timely documentation every step of the way. Multichem’s commitment to
excellence and attention to detail make them a reliable partner for handling complex customs
processes. It has been a pleasure collaborating with such a dedicated team.

###### Canlinx Logistics India Pvt. Ltd.

###### Vijay Singh

###### Director

We partnered with Multichem 10 years ago to introduce our products to the Indian market, and the
results have been outstanding. Multichem’s deep market knowledge, strategic approach, and commitment
to excellence have driven an impressive sales growth of 40% CAGR over the past decade. Their ability
to effectively position our products, build long-term client relationships, and ensure seamless
distribution has exceeded our expectations. We value Multichem not just as a distributor, but as a
true partner in our growth journey.

###### Qingdao Thor Industrial Co. Ltd.

###### Jack Xue

###### General Manager

Our partnership with Multichem has been exceptional, thanks to their highly efficient domestic
logistics team and world-class storage facilities. Coordinating with Multichem is always smooth,
ensuring timely distribution of goods across our extensive network of 5,000 destinations in India.
Their commitment to excellence aligns perfectly with our mission to handle all cargos with
precision.

## Turning Functional Ingredients
## into Practical Advantage

More Than Supply — Built for Application Performance

Nexus Ingredient is a specialist in [clean-label functional ingredients][119], supplying food and
beverage manufacturers across the US, UK and Australia. We develop and supply proprietary
clean-label ingredient solutions that solve real formulation challenges — from [shelf-life
extension][120], [moisture management][121] and texture improvement, to [sugar reduction and
elimination][122], to clean-label [emulsification][123] and [stabilization][124] systems.

We specialise in five main functional categories — [humectants][125], [natural
preservatives][126], [dietary fibers][127] for binding and texture improvement, [sugar
replacement][128], and [emulsifier and stabiliser systems][129] — allowing us to maintain a depth of
technical knowledge and ingredient performance that serves a broad spectrum of [applications][130].
Every ingredient in our range is proprietary or carefully curated, fully certified, allergen-free,
non-GMO and free from E-numbers.

For food scientists and R&D teams, we offer [formulation support][131] alongside supply — helping
you select the right grade, dosage and format for your application, and providing the full
documentation package required for product development and regulatory compliance.

## Designed for Commercial Success

**Performance in Real Recipes, Built for Scale**

Consumers and retailers are moving away from synthetic additives, and manufacturers need natural
alternatives that perform in real recipes — not just on paper — without compromising cost, quality
or throughput. Our [ingredient solutions][132] are developed to meet that standard, supporting
cleaner labels, sugar reduction, fibre enrichment and extended shelf life across a wide range of
food categories.

We supply in bulk B2B formats across the US, UK and Australia, backed by full technical and
compliance documentation and hands-on formulation support — helping your product move from trial to
production with confidence.

The result is a partnership built for the long term: natural ingredients that deliver functional
performance, commercial viability and the consistency your business depends on.

## Questions Manufacturers Ask

##### Who does Nexus Ingredient supply?

Nexus Ingredient is a global B2B supplier of clean-label functional ingredients to food and beverage
manufacturers, contract manufacturers and brand owners worldwide, with established hubs in the
United States, the United Kingdom and Australia. We supply businesses, not consumers, and don't sell
in retail pack sizes.

##### What types of ingredients does Nexus Ingredient supply?

We specialise in five functional categories: natural humectants, natural preservatives, dietary
fibers for binding and texture, sugar replacers, and emulsifier and stabiliser systems. The range
includes CapMoist®, CapMoist® EnergyWell and CapMoist® Sugar Free humectants; MoistPlus®;
FiberWorks® soluble fibers; MetaSweet® IMO; HaloSweet® allulose; FlaxSmooth®, Unifier® and
CitruSmart® emulsifier/stabiliser systems; and the CapBlock® range of natural preservatives.

##### Can Nexus Ingredient help with clean-label reformulation?

Yes. We help manufacturers reformulate for cleaner labels using natural functional ingredients that
support sweetness, texture, moisture control, stability and shelf life — backed by technical support
and sample availability.

 

##### Does Nexus Ingredient offer samples and technical support?

Yes. We provide samples to qualified manufacturers and offer formulation support across moisture
control, texture, binding, sugar reduction and preservation — helping you select the right grade,
dosage and format, and move from trial to production.

##### How do I request a sample or pricing?

Use the Request a Sample form or contact our team at [info@nexusingredient.com][148]. To help us
respond, please use a valid business email and include your company website — due to inquiry volume
we're unable to respond to personal email domains such as Gmail or Hotmail. We'll confirm
availability for your region and application.

##### What certifications and label claims do you support?

Depending on the specific product and market, we can provide Kosher, Halal, Non-GMO, Gluten-Free and
Vegan documentation, along with allergen statements, specifications and CoA, SDS, nutrition data,
country of origin, no-irradiation and BSE/TSE-free statements, and Prop 65 status where relevant.
Available claims depend on the exact product and the market it's sold into.

##### Are Nexus Ingredient's products natural and allergen-free?

Every ingredient in the range is proprietary or carefully curated, and is natural, clean label,
allergen-free, non-GMO and free from E-numbers. Specific attributes are confirmed per product on its
own specification and data sheet.

##### What documentation does Nexus Ingredient provide for R&D and regulatory teams?

For qualified customers we provide a full documentation package — product specification and
Certificate of Analysis, SDS, allergen and nutrition information, and the relevant certification and
country-of-origin statements — to support product development and regulatory compliance in your
market.

## Turning Functional Ingredients
## into Practical Advantage

More Than Supply — Built for Application Performance

Nexus Ingredient is a specialist in [clean-label functional ingredients][119], supplying food and
beverage manufacturers across the US, UK and Australia. We develop and supply proprietary
clean-label ingredient solutions that solve real formulation challenges — from [shelf-life
extension][120], [moisture management][121] and texture improvement, to [sugar reduction and
elimination][122], to clean-label [emulsification][123] and [stabilization][124] systems.

We specialise in five main functional categories — [humectants][125], [natural
preservatives][126], [dietary fibers][127] for binding and texture improvement, [sugar
replacement][128], and [emulsifier and stabiliser systems][129] — allowing us to maintain a depth of
technical knowledge and ingredient performance that serves a broad spectrum of [applications][130].
Every ingredient in our range is proprietary or carefully curated, fully certified, allergen-free,
non-GMO and free from E-numbers.

For food scientists and R&D teams, we offer [formulation support][131] alongside supply — helping
you select the right grade, dosage and format for your application, and providing the full
documentation package required for product development and regulatory compliance.

## Designed for Commercial Success

**Performance in Real Recipes, Built for Scale**

Consumers and retailers are moving away from synthetic additives, and manufacturers need natural
alternatives that perform in real recipes — not just on paper — without compromising cost, quality
or throughput. Our [ingredient solutions][132] are developed to meet that standard, supporting
cleaner labels, sugar reduction, fibre enrichment and extended shelf life across a wide range of
food categories.

We supply in bulk B2B formats across the US, UK and Australia, backed by full technical and
compliance documentation and hands-on formulation support — helping your product move from trial to
production with confidence.

The result is a partnership built for the long term: natural ingredients that deliver functional
performance, commercial viability and the consistency your business depends on.

## Questions Manufacturers Ask

##### Who does Nexus Ingredient supply?

Nexus Ingredient is a global B2B supplier of clean-label functional ingredients to food and beverage
manufacturers, contract manufacturers and brand owners worldwide, with established hubs in the
United States, the United Kingdom and Australia. We supply businesses, not consumers, and don't sell
in retail pack sizes.

##### What types of ingredients does Nexus Ingredient supply?

We specialise in five functional categories: natural humectants, natural preservatives, dietary
fibers for binding and texture, sugar replacers, and emulsifier and stabiliser systems. The range
includes CapMoist®, CapMoist® EnergyWell and CapMoist® Sugar Free humectants; MoistPlus®;
FiberWorks® soluble fibers; MetaSweet® IMO; HaloSweet® allulose; FlaxSmooth®, Unifier® and
CitruSmart® emulsifier/stabiliser systems; and the CapBlock® range of natural preservatives.

##### Can Nexus Ingredient help with clean-label reformulation?

Yes. We help manufacturers reformulate for cleaner labels using natural functional ingredients that
support sweetness, texture, moisture control, stability and shelf life — backed by technical support
and sample availability.

 

##### Does Nexus Ingredient offer samples and technical support?

Yes. We provide samples to qualified manufacturers and offer formulation support across moisture
control, texture, binding, sugar reduction and preservation — helping you select the right grade,
dosage and format, and move from trial to production.

##### How do I request a sample or pricing?

Use the Request a Sample form or contact our team at [info@nexusingredient.com][148]. To help us
respond, please use a valid business email and include your company website — due to inquiry volume
we're unable to respond to personal email domains such as Gmail or Hotmail. We'll confirm
availability for your region and application.

##### What certifications and label claims do you support?

Depending on the specific product and market, we can provide Kosher, Halal, Non-GMO, Gluten-Free and
Vegan documentation, along with allergen statements, specifications and CoA, SDS, nutrition data,
country of origin, no-irradiation and BSE/TSE-free statements, and Prop 65 status where relevant.
Available claims depend on the exact product and the market it's sold into.

##### Are Nexus Ingredient's products natural and allergen-free?

Every ingredient in the range is proprietary or carefully curated, and is natural, clean label,
allergen-free, non-GMO and free from E-numbers. Specific attributes are confirmed per product on its
own specification and data sheet.

##### What documentation does Nexus Ingredient provide for R&D and regulatory teams?

For qualified customers we provide a full documentation package — product specification and
Certificate of Analysis, SDS, allergen and nutrition information, and the relevant certification and
country-of-origin statements — to support product development and regulatory compliance in your
market.

FOOD, POLYMER & PERSONAL CARE SOLUTIONS

# Welcome to our World of Emulsifiers and Stabilisers

[FOOD][32][POLYMERS][33][PERSONAL CARE][34]

With over a century of experience, we help customers create high-performing products and solve
formulation challenges through tailored solutions and close collaboration. Across food, polymers,
and personal care, our products support sustainability by reducing waste, improving raw material
efficiency, and extending shelf life – helping manufacturers optimise production and contribute to
responsible innovation.

Expertise and innovation 

Since 1917, Palsgaard has led the way in emulsifier development, inventing the world’s first
plant-based food emulsifier. Our specialists now operate from nine global application centres,
delivering tailored solutions for food, polymers, and personal care. From enhancing product
performance to exploring new trends and reformulating for changing market needs, we blend deep
technical expertise with a collaborative approach to deliver lasting value.

Driving ESG together

Responsibility and ESG are deeply ingrained in Palsgaard’s heritage. We help customers reduce food
waste, optimise raw material use, and extend shelf life, while also aiming to lower carbon emissions
and improve production practices. Within our own operations, we invest in renewable energy,
responsible sourcing, and resource efficiency, continually setting ambitious targets to benefit
people, planet, and society. Our RSPO SG-certified emulsifiers and alternatives can help you meet
your ESG goals and regulatory requirements.

Collaborative partnerships

We believe business is personal. By working closely with our customers, we gain a deep understanding
of your goals and challenges, co-creating solutions that make a real difference. Whether you’re
launching a new product, refining a process, or tackling production issues, our experts are with you
every step of the way. With Palsgaard, you gain more than an ingredient supplier – you gain a
committed partner focused on your success.

FOOD, POLYMER & PERSONAL CARE SOLUTIONS

# Welcome to our World of Emulsifiers and Stabilisers

[FOOD][32][POLYMERS][33][PERSONAL CARE][34]

With over a century of experience, we help customers create high-performing products and solve
formulation challenges through tailored solutions and close collaboration. Across food, polymers,
and personal care, our products support sustainability by reducing waste, improving raw material
efficiency, and extending shelf life – helping manufacturers optimise production and contribute to
responsible innovation.

Expertise and innovation 

Since 1917, Palsgaard has led the way in emulsifier development, inventing the world’s first
plant-based food emulsifier. Our specialists now operate from nine global application centres,
delivering tailored solutions for food, polymers, and personal care. From enhancing product
performance to exploring new trends and reformulating for changing market needs, we blend deep
technical expertise with a collaborative approach to deliver lasting value.

Driving ESG together

Responsibility and ESG are deeply ingrained in Palsgaard’s heritage. We help customers reduce food
waste, optimise raw material use, and extend shelf life, while also aiming to lower carbon emissions
and improve production practices. Within our own operations, we invest in renewable energy,
responsible sourcing, and resource efficiency, continually setting ambitious targets to benefit
people, planet, and society. Our RSPO SG-certified emulsifiers and alternatives can help you meet
your ESG goals and regulatory requirements.

Collaborative partnerships

We believe business is personal. By working closely with our customers, we gain a deep understanding
of your goals and challenges, co-creating solutions that make a real difference. Whether you’re
launching a new product, refining a process, or tackling production issues, our experts are with you
every step of the way. With Palsgaard, you gain more than an ingredient supplier – you gain a
committed partner focused on your success.

## Prakash Chemicals International Private Limited

Prakash Chemicals International is a global chemical distribution and manufacturing company catering
to a wide range of industry verticals with a customer base spread across 120 countries all over the
world. We partner with the chemical industry and offer an array of value-added products and bespoke
solutions that accelerate growth for all our stakeholders. 
 
With more than 75 years of experience, we have evolved to be India’s leading player in bulk,
specialty and performance chemicals. Our footprint has expanded worldwide, enabled by a unique
business model that combines global thinking with local values. This has resulted in long-standing
partnerships with our clients, helping them achieve their business goals through better product
quality and deeper market understanding.

[ Know More ][50]

## The Prakash Advantage

At PCIPL, our operational philosophy is embodied in our three distinct business models: ACE, MAX,
and PRO. These series represent our comprehensive approach to the chemical value chain, ensuring
unparalleled service and product excellence, refined through years of industry leadership. 

## Global Distribution of Bulk Chemicals

The ACE series signifies our unwavering commitment to delivering bulk chemicals with consistent
quality and exceptional efficiency. Our unrivalled market knowledge and extensive experience,
cultivated across decades in the global market, translate into reliable distribution worldwide,
providing clients with a significant and proven competitive edge. 
* Quality Assurance
* Comprehensive Logistics Solution
* Efficient Documentation

## Custom Manufacturing of Fine & Speciality Chemicals

The MAX Series focuses on custom manufacturing & private labelling of fine and speciality chemicals,
where our profound proficiency in products and applications allows us to create tailor-made,
quality-controlled chemicals. We precisely match your unique specifications,
ensuring optimal performance for your specific needs, drawing upon a deep well of
accumulated know-how. 
* Customised Specifications 
* Customised Packaging 
* Customised Inventory Points 

## Innovative Manufacturing of Performance Chemicals 

The PRO Series is dedicated to Innovative Manufacturing Performance Chemicals. Through in-house
process innovation and indigenous R&D chemical solutions, we develop performance chemicals that meet
the most critical customer needs and adhere to the highest sustainability standards, all underpinned
by our long-standing commitment to progress. 
* Technology Performance 
* Enhanced Solution 
* Process & Application Development

### Frequently asked questions

#### [How Onnovo helps industrial manufacturers?][50]

With Onnovo’s hygiene management programs, microbiological analysis, and high-performance
preservatives, manufacturers can Prevent microbial contaminatio Ensure regulatory complianc Extend
product shelf lif Reduce operational and recall cost Maintain brand reputation Would you like me to
refine this further or tailor it to a specific industry?

#### [Common concerns with microbial contamination?][51]

**1. Product Spoilage & Reduced Shelf Life**
Microbial growth can degrade product quality, leading to discoloration, odor, texture changes, and
separation.
This results in shortened shelf life and potential customer dissatisfaction.
**2. Regulatory Non-Compliance & Product Recalls**
Many industries (cosmetics, personal care, coatings, etc.) must meet strict microbial safety
regulations.
Contaminated products may fail stability tests or lead to costly recalls and legal action.
**3. Safety Risks for Consumers**
Some microbes can cause skin irritation, infections, or allergic reactions, making products unsafe.
In severe cases, contamination could lead to serious health concerns for end users.
**4. Production Downtime & Increased Costs**
Contamination may require shutdowns for deep cleaning, resulting in lost production time and
revenue.
Additional testing, reformulation, and disposal of contaminated batches increase operational costs.
**5. Brand Reputation Damage**
Customers losing trust due to quality issues can result in negative reviews, brand damage, and loss
of market share.
Rebuilding a reputation after contamination is costly and time-consuming.
**6. Ineffective Preservation & Poor Formulation**
Weak or improperly selected preservatives may not provide sufficient microbial protection, leading
to contamination.
Formulations need optimized preservative systems to ensure long-term product stability.

#### [Issues with to microbial degradation in paints?][52]

**1. Viscosity Changes & Phase Separation**
Microbial activity can break down the thickening agents in paints, causing reduced viscosity and
separation of components.
This leads to inconsistent application and poor final finish.
**2. Odor Formation**
Contaminated paints often develop foul, musty, or sour odors due to microbial metabolism.
This is a clear sign of spoilage, making the product unusable and unsellable.
**3. Discoloration & Staining**
Bacteria and fungi can produce pigments or degrade colorants, leading to unexpected color shifts.
This affects paint aesthetics and may result in costly product returns.
**4. Loss of Adhesion & Film Integrity**
Microbial degradation can weaken binding agents, reducing adhesion to surfaces.
The final coating may peel, crack, or flake prematurely, affecting performance.
**5. Surface Mold & Biofilm Growth**
Fungi and bacteria can grow on painted surfaces, creating visible mold spots or slime layers.
This is a major problem in high-humidity environments, such as bathrooms or outdoor coatings.
**6. Shortened Shelf Life**
Microbial activity can accelerate product spoilage, leading to clogged spray systems, increased
sedimentation, and overall instability.
This forces manufacturers to discard contaminated batches, leading to financial loss.
**7. Regulatory Compliance Issues**
Paints and coatings must meet strict microbial control regulations in many industries.
Contamination can lead to failed quality tests, customer complaints, or product recalls.

#### [How Onnovo helps paint manufacturers?][53]

With high-performance biocides, antimicrobial additives, and hygiene management solutions, Onnovo
helps manufacturers: Prevent microbial degradation in wet-state and dry-film coatings Extend shelf
life and maintain product stability Improve film protection against fungi, algae, and bacteria
Ensure regulatory compliance and reduce product failure risks

#### [How Onnovo helps industrial manufacturers?][50]

With Onnovo’s hygiene management programs, microbiological analysis, and high-performance

refine this further or tailor it to a specific industry?

#### [Common concerns with microbial contamination?][51]

**1. Product Spoilage & Reduced Shelf Life**
Microbial growth can degrade product quality, leading to discoloration, odor, texture changes, and
separation.
This results in shortened shelf life and potential customer dissatisfaction.
**2. Regulatory Non-Compliance & Product Recalls**
Many industries (cosmetics, personal care, coatings, etc.) must meet strict microbial safety
regulations.
Contaminated products may fail stability tests or lead to costly recalls and legal action.
**3. Safety Risks for Consumers**
Some microbes can cause skin irritation, infections, or allergic reactions, making products unsafe.
In severe cases, contamination could lead to serious health concerns for end users.
**4. Production Downtime & Increased Costs**
Contamination may require shutdowns for deep cleaning, resulting in lost production time and
revenue.
Additional testing, reformulation, and disposal of contaminated batches increase operational costs.
**5. Brand Reputation Damage**
Customers losing trust due to quality issues can result in negative reviews, brand damage, and loss
of market share.
Rebuilding a reputation after contamination is costly and time-consuming.
**6. Ineffective Preservation & Poor Formulation**
Weak or improperly selected preservatives may not provide sufficient microbial protection, leading
to contamination.
Formulations need optimized preservative systems to ensure long-term product stability.

#### [Issues with to microbial degradation in paints?][52]

**1. Viscosity Changes & Phase Separation**
Microbial activity can break down the thickening agents in paints, causing reduced viscosity and
separation of components.
This leads to inconsistent application and poor final finish.
**2. Odor Formation**
Contaminated paints often develop foul, musty, or sour odors due to microbial metabolism.
This is a clear sign of spoilage, making the product unusable and unsellable.
**3. Discoloration & Staining**
Bacteria and fungi can produce pigments or degrade colorants, leading to unexpected color shifts.
This affects paint aesthetics and may result in costly product returns.
**4. Loss of Adhesion & Film Integrity**
Microbial degradation can weaken binding agents, reducing adhesion to surfaces.
The final coating may peel, crack, or flake prematurely, affecting performance.
**5. Surface Mold & Biofilm Growth**
Fungi and bacteria can grow on painted surfaces, creating visible mold spots or slime layers.
This is a major problem in high-humidity environments, such as bathrooms or outdoor coatings.
**6. Shortened Shelf Life**
Microbial activity can accelerate product spoilage, leading to clogged spray systems, increased
sedimentation, and overall instability.
This forces manufacturers to discard contaminated batches, leading to financial loss.
**7. Regulatory Compliance Issues**
Paints and coatings must meet strict microbial control regulations in many industries.
Contamination can lead to failed quality tests, customer complaints, or product recalls.

#### [How Onnovo helps paint manufacturers?][53]

With high-performance biocides, antimicrobial additives, and hygiene management solutions, Onnovo
helps manufacturers: Prevent microbial degradation in wet-state and dry-film coatings Extend shelf
life and maintain product stability Improve film protection against fungi, algae, and bacteria
Ensure regulatory compliance and reduce product failure risks

Punature strictly follows the ISO9001, ISO 22000, Kosher and Halal food quality certification
requirements, and strictly controls every link of the production process from raw material
procurement to finished products. The entire supply chain is under the control of the comprehensive
quality and food safety management system, forming a closed loop to strictly control product
quality.

various countries and has obtained certification as halal, kosher, vegan, non-GMO among others for
our products. The quality and safety of Punature products has been recognized in China and abroad.
Punature guarantees the quality compliance of its products and has been sold to Southeast Asia,
Russia, Eastern and Western Europe, North and South America, and many other countries and regions,
and has been recognized by more than 140 countries and regions around the world.

## Bespoke chemical manufacturing services for almost 50 years

We’ve been manufacturing chemicals since 1977, so we’re equipped to take on any chemical
manufacturing job you may require.

With our team of experts and the latest technology, we are continuously improving our chemical
manufacturing services.

[Learn more][195] about the history of ReAgent.

## Custom Chemical Manufacturing
* Product & formulation development
* Blending custom chemicals and [cleaning chemicals][196]
* Bottle filling services, including [glass ampoules][197]
* [Chemical repacking][198], repacking, and labelling
* Delivery and export, either to you or your customers

We can produce a variety of sizes, from 2ml glass vials to 1,000L containers and even tankers.

[ View Our Services ][199]
[Chemical Manufacturing services]

## Chemical Manufacturing Equipment
* Mixing vessels
* Cleanrooms
* Mechanical mixing equipment
* Handling equipment
* Filtration facilities capable of filtration down to 0.2 micron
* Industrial heaters

## Bespoke chemical manufacturing services for almost 50 years

We’ve been manufacturing chemicals since 1977, so we’re equipped to take on any chemical
manufacturing job you may require.

With our team of experts and the latest technology, we are continuously improving our chemical
manufacturing services.

[Learn more][195] about the history of ReAgent.

## Custom Chemical Manufacturing
* Product & formulation development
* Blending custom chemicals and [cleaning chemicals][196]
* Bottle filling services, including [glass ampoules][197]
* [Chemical repacking][198], repacking, and labelling
* Delivery and export, either to you or your customers

We can produce a variety of sizes, from 2ml glass vials to 1,000L containers and even tankers.

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping

in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

customers develop new product recipes tailored right to the favors of the targeted consumers.
[Talk To An Expert][39]
Formulation Training & Consulting
Our expert team offers online formulation training courses and consultation services to our
customers and the public. We aim to help businesses to produce better and safer products in a
commercial way.
[Get Free Consultation][40]
Contract Manufacturing
To our customers who don't intend to manufacture on their own, Yeser Chemicals offers contract
manufacturing services for ready-for-sale or semi-finished products under their private labels.
[Get A Quote][41]
New Plant Design & Setup
To those customers who are ready to set up new production plants of detergents, personal care
products and cosmetics, our expert team, offers extensive expertise in designing, establishing,
commissioning, and troubleshooting new production facilities.
[Get Free Consultation][42]
Global Sourcing & Shipping
Besides those products we produce and regularly supply, our team also puts a lot of effort into
sourcing products globally and shipping them to our customers at the best possible conditions
according to their specific needs.
[Get A Quote][43]

## Cutting-edge Facilities

Manufacturing coconut-derived bioingredients has been Yeser Chemicals’ core business. Our production
plant is elaborately designed and facilitated with various cutting-edge facilities…

Manufacturing coconut-derived bioingredients has been Yeser Chemicals’ core business. Our production
plant covers an area of 2.5 hectares. It’s elaborately designed and facilited with material tanks,
production workshops, warehouses, waste treatment equipment, and laboratories.

Our workshops are equipped with 13 fully automatic production and canning lines, manufacturing a
variety of key ingredients used in Home & Personal Care Products, including CDEA, CMEA, CAB, CAO,
EGDS, and so on.

[ Explore Our Facilities ][44]

## We Ship Wordwide

And we are recruiting territorial agents worldwide

**Yeser Chemicals **ships products to our customers worldwide by Ocean Shipping, Air Cargo, and
Express Delivery. Our logistics team is committed to choosing the best shipping method and picking
the right carrier to ensure our clients receive the ordered goods at the earliest time and the
lowest cost.

To enhance our local presence globally, we seek trustworthy, professional, competent individuals or
businesses to be our territorial agents. 

[ Our Shipping Policy ][45]

**Yeser Chemicals** highly values accurate information and broad knowledge. Our team keeps a close

We are enthusiastic about sharing our knowledge, practical know-how, and industry news with regular
and prospective customers and anyone interested in learning more about our industry.

[about us]

private enterprise, we now are mainly engaged in the R&D, production and sale of food additives. Our

additives.Jiangsu Zipin is one of the professional **manufacturers and suppliers in China.** There

sales service personnel, well-operated marketing system and efficient after-sales service network,
